subject: integration
name: THORNode (ninerealms)
summary: The THORChain node (THORNODE_NET_0_1), for the browser's own swaps: asks Nine Realms and Liquify for quotes, vault addresses and deposit status. A vault is named only when both list the same address and router; a quote and a status come from the first that answers, and the facilitator checks a quote against that vault and the person's destination. Nothing proves any answer against THORChain itself, so two agreeing or lying operators are believed. Level 3, not 4: it relies on two public servers, which see the pair, amounts and later the destination. Judged here by its publisher.
